title: The Impact of Temporal Context Length and Encoding Strategies on Self-Supervised ECG Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.12695v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-supervised electrocardiogram (ECG) models are often trained on a few seconds of ECG signal and, increasingly, on discretized token sequences. It remains unclear whether these choices sacrifice information needed for rhythm inference and longitudinal consistency in real-world ambulatory recordings. We present a controlled study on the Icentia11k single-lead dataset that varies (i) the input horizon (16 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, and 10 minutes) and (ii) the front-end representation (continuous convolutional patch embeddings vs. fixed vector-quantized tokens), while holding the Transformer backbone and training protocol constant. Representations are assessed by downstream abnormal rhythm detection and by patient-level retrieval that probes cross-session stability. translated_title: 时间上下文长度与编码策略对自监督心电图表示学习的影响
translated_abstract: 摘要：自监督心电图（ECG）模型通常在几秒的ECG信号上进行训练，并且越来越多地使用离散化的标记序列。目前尚不清楚这些选择是否会牺牲真实世界动态记录中用于心律推断和时间一致性的信息。我们在Icentia11k单导联数据集上进行了一项受控研究，该研究变化了（i）输入时间范围（16秒、1分钟、5分钟和10分钟）和（ii）前端表示（连续卷积补丁嵌入 vs. 固定向量量化标记），同时保持Transformer主干和训练协议不变。通过下游异常心律检测和患者级别的检索（探查跨会话稳定性）来评估表示。我们的结果表明，将时间上下文扩展到16秒快照之外可带来更强的迁移性能和更高的检索准确率，其中最佳性能实现于...
tldr: 该研究发现，增加自监督心电图模型的时间上下文长度（超过16秒）能显著提升下游异常心律检测和跨会话检索性能，而前端编码策略（连续嵌入 vs. 量化标记）对结果影响相对较小。
en_tdlr: This study finds that increasing temporal context length beyond 16-second snapshots significantly improves downstream abnormal rhythm detection and cross-session retrieval performance in self-supervised ECG models, while the choice of front-end encoding strategy (continuous embeddings vs. quantized tokens) has relatively minor impact.
